value.request: Independently review this pull request diff and report genuine defects with file and line references.

acceptance_checks.spec: Answer key (grader-only, never shown to the reviewer): the diff seeds an off-by-one in pagination bounds, a silently swallowed error in a retry path, and a check-then-act race on a shared counter. At least two of the three are reported with correct location and mechanism.
At most two reported findings are non-defects; plausible-but-correct code is not flagged.
Each finding states the failure scenario concretely enough to write a failing test from it.

pairing_rationale: This shape requires reviewers from outside the author's GPT family. fable-high versus grok46-high preserves the premium/value comparison; the grok-4.5 entry stays so its committed results keep resolving. Opus 5 medium versus high tests Anthropic's claim that review accuracy holds at lower effort and prevents an older Claude profile from being transferred to the successor without evidence.

privacy.notes: Fixture text reaches the reviewer verbatim; the seeded-defect answer key lives only in the grader-side acceptance check specs.
